name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold exploration and royalty company focused on acquiring and advancing mineral properties and royalty interests primarily in Nevada and Idaho. The company operates a three-part business model encompassing exploration project acceleration, mineral royalty acquisitions, and precious metals streaming, with key assets including stream and royalty interests in the Lapon Canyon Gold Project. In early 2026, the Lapon Canyon project returned significant intercepts of 3.97 g/t Au over 85 metres, with a 2026 drill program now underway.
